name: load
description: Pace Claude's heavy work to the machine it runs on, with configurable hard caps

caps.title: Hard caps
caps.description: pool:limit:regex entries. A Bash command matching the regex is refused while `limit` processes matching its pool already run. Entries sharing a pool share its limit. Empty caps nothing.

maxLoadPerCore.title: Load cap per core
maxLoadPerCore.description: Refuse capped commands while the load average per core is above this. 0 turns it off.

paceLoadPerCore.title: Pacing threshold per core
paceLoadPerCore.description: Remind the model to pace heavy work once load per core reaches this, again at twice it, or under memory pressure. 0 turns pacing off.
